text_block_list.name: Buena & Cesario
text_block_list.text:
The Gourmet Fair in Tokyo Racecourse
is officially underway~!!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Today's unveiling event has tons in store for you!
There are gourmet quizzes, food tastings, and more!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
What we will be handing out at the tasting session is the fair's top recommendation: our special frappe!
Please look forward to it♪

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Huh!? A traffic jam...!?

text_block_list.name: Event Staff
text_block_list.text:
Yes... The delivery truck carrying the frappes from the supplier got caught up...
They're already reporting a one-hour delay.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
One hour... It won't make it in time for the scheduled tasting session.
We have no choice but to prepare an alternative...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: ...Agreed. Let us contact everyone we can and find shops that might be able to provide substitute sample items.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: If that doesn't work... we could cancel the tasting event... and issue coupons instead...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Yes. Just in case, we'll proceed with multiple plans simultaneously while reaching out to every booth.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: —Um, excuse me!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Why don't we wait for the frappes to arrive, desu ne?

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: The shop prepared everything just for today, right? All so they could bring a smile to the race fans' faces, desu ne.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: The transport staff delivering them right now surely feel the same way. They're working so hard to bring them to our fans!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: If so, I want to connect those feelings to everyone. As an event organizer, I want to do my absolute best too!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: So, what if... we hand out the frappes as souvenirs at the very end? If we do that—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: —Ah. That way we should make it in time! Let's adjust the stage schedule as well!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: We'll support the transport from our end too. We just need them to break through the traffic!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: If they're souvenirs... let's elaborate on the cup decorations as well...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Then let's take to the stage! We'll keep the venue hype and fired up until the frappes arrive!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: —Yeah! Thank you, everyone!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: We have a brief announcement for everyone. In truth, the frappe tasting scheduled for this moment has been delayed in transit...

text_block_list.name: Audience
text_block_list.text: Ehh?! Does that mean we won't get any~?!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Don't worry! Everyone is working their hardest right now so each and every one of you can taste it, desu!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: —Racetrack gourmet food is a heartwarming presence that truly enlivens URA events.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: The collaborating shops helping us this time are also places that enrich the hearts of us Umamusume—

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Every single item is a warm, delicious treat packed with all our precious memories.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: We want all of you to taste such wonderful gourmet food no matter what. That is why we're giving it our all right now.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: So, we will be adjusting our schedule and handing out the frappes as parting gifts at the finale. Please look forward to it, desu ne!

text_block_list.name: Audience
text_block_list.text: Thank you~~!! We can't wait—!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Now then, while we wait for the frappes, let's kick off our special segment!

text_block_list.name: Buena & Cesario
text_block_list.text: Buena & Cesario's Recommended Gourmet Talk!
(Woooahhh!!)
The Gourmet Fair's unveiling event was a massive hit—and over the course of the month-long fair, huge crowds gathered day after day.
